instruction: Start from the counts in in/stock.json and apply each line of in/moves.txt ('<date> <item> <+/-qty>') in order. An unknown item starts at 0. A move that would make a count negative is skipped. Write the final counts to out/stock.json and the skipped lines verbatim, in order, to out/rejected.txt.
note: All paths are relative to the workspace root.
